name: variant
description: Visual emphasis level. Prefer a single 'solid' button per view — the primary CTA that needs the most emphasis; multiple solid buttons make it harder for users to identify the primary action. 'weak' pairs well as a secondary action alongside solid. 'outline' / 'ghost' are for tertiary, low-emphasis actions. Default: 'solid'.

name: size
description: Size of the button. Choose based on context and required click area. Default: 'medium'.

name: intent
description: Semantic color intent conveying the nature of the action. For irreversible actions (delete, reset), always use 'danger' to clearly warn the user. Default: 'primary'.

name: rounded
description: Corner radius (small, medium, large — 'large' is a full pill). In the game theme the pixel frame's corners are stepped instead: square, one-step notch, two-step. Default: 'medium'.

name: fullWidth
description: Whether the button fills the full width of its parent container. Default: false.

name: disabled
description: Whether the button is disabled. When disabled, click events do not fire. Default: false.
